name: Elizabeth Scott
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Elizabeth's married name as Millheim (Milheine, Millhime), wife of Jacob Millheim (1830-1908). It shows her in the 1870 and 1880 censuses with children born from 1859 and gives her death as 31 Mar 1917; her Find a Grave entry is indexed as 'Elizabeth Scott Millheim' (S1).
